newsitem.title: THAILAND: Jasmine Int'l cancells CDs issue.
newsitem.headline: Jasmine Int'l cancells CDs issue.

text.p: Thai telecommunications firm, Jasmine International Plc, said on Friday the company had scrapped its plan to issue convertible debentures worth up to $125 million.
"After careful consideration by the board of directors it found this sort of mobilisation was not suitable," Jasmine said in a filing to the Stock Exchange of Thailand.
The company will also scrap its plan to issue 30 million new shares which will be reserved for the conversion of the planned debentures, it said.
Jasmine's registered capital will total 3.34 billion baht following the cancellation, it said.
